summary.name: Vidwall
summary.one_liner: Vidwall is a Mac app that sets MP4 or MOV videos, camera feeds, or web pages as animated desktop wallpapers.
use_cases: Set a 4K video as a moving desktop background
Show a live camera feed as wallpaper
Display a web page as desktop background
Add eye-catching backgrounds to screen recordings
Use animated wallpaper on a specific window
summary.what_it_does: Vidwall lets users set 4K videos in MP4 and MOV formats as dynamic desktop wallpapers. Videos can be dragged and dropped into the app window and applied with a click. It can also use a camera feed or any webpage as the desktop wallpaper. The latest listed updates add support for displaying web wallpapers on specified windows and quick enable/disable options in the settings sidebar. The page also lists a lock screen animation feature in the directory listing.
notable: Drag-and-drop MP4/MOV import as desktop wallpaper
Camera feed or any webpage as wallpaper
Open source on GitHub per the awesome-mac listing
caveats: In-app purchases: All Access Lifetime $3.99 and All Access Monthly $0.99
The app has not received enough ratings or reviews to display an overview
